name: Empowered Autogenerator
oracle_text:
This artifact enters tapped.
{T}: Put a charge counter on this artifact. Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of charge counters on this artifact.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Put a charge counter on this artifact. Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of charge counters on this artifact.

needs.what: a mana ability whose rider effect (add_counters on the source) happens BEFORE the mana is made, so a variable add_mana amount (any_one_color with amount counters_on charge, self) reads the count after the counter is placed; the payment solver's mana_amount must also see the post-rider count when deciding how much the source can produce
needs.why_existing_wont_do: loader/mana.py _split_mana_rider requires the add_mana half first and the rider after it, and costs.py adds mana via mana_amount (evaluated before _run_mana_rider), so X would read the pre-tap count. Writing amount as counters_on + 1 with a trailing add_counters rider is an approximation that goes wrong under counter replacement (Doubling Season / Hardened Scales put 2, real X counts both), and making it a non-mana activated ability would put it on the stack, which a mana ability (605.1a) never uses
needs.closest_existing: add_mana any_one_color + amount (Helga) with an add_counters rider (Temple of Cyclical Time shape)
